message: The other day, I realized I’d never actually practiced my fire escape plan. So there I was, dramatically pretending to be a firefighter while my cat looked at me like I’d lost my mind. 😂 I had to laugh at myself, but it was a gentle reminder that even the best intentions need a little action behind them. So, maybe it’s time to gather the family and do a little practice run—just to keep things light and safe! Have you ever done a fire drill at home?
